raw_text:
name: dotnet-csharp-source-generators
Create and consume Roslyn source generators: `IIncrementalGenerator`, syntax providers, semantic analysis, emission, diagnostics, `CSharpGeneratorDriver` testing, NuGet packaging; built-ins `[GeneratedRegex]`, `[LoggerMessage]`, System.Text.Json (`[JsonSerializable]`). Analyzers/code fixes: [skill:dotnet-roslyn-analyzers]. C# features: [skill:dotnet-csharp-modern-patterns]. Naming: [skill:dotnet-csharp-coding-standards].

Target `netstandard2.0`; use `LangVersion>latest`. Always target `netstandard2.0`. Always use `IIncrementalGenerator` over the legacy `ISourceGenerator`.

Incremental pipeline: filter early (`ForAttributeWithMetadataName` or tight `CreateSyntaxProvider` predicate); transform to simple data. Never pass `ISymbol` or `SyntaxNode` through the pipeline. Use `record struct`/`IEquatable<T>` for value equality. Emit deterministic output with `// <auto-generated/>` and `#nullable enable`. Group by fully qualified type name; use fully qualified type names and collision-safe hint names. Handle global namespaces. Production generators should support generic/nested types; report diagnostics for unsupported shapes rather than emitting invalid code.

Report errors/warnings via `SourceProductionContext`, not exceptions. Capture `Location` from syntax for location-specific diagnostics; `Location` is not value-equatable, so exclude it from equality or report before projecting to value types. Use `RegisterPostInitializationOutput` for user-code-independent marker/helper types. File naming: `{TypeName}.{Feature}.g.cs`. Prefer raw string literals for templates.

Test in-memory using `CSharpGeneratorDriver`; verify diagnostics, generated trees, and output. Verify.SourceGenerators supports snapshot tests.

`[GeneratedRegex]`: method `static partial`, returns `Regex`, in `partial class`/`partial struct`; supports all `RegexOptions` except `RegexOptions.Compiled` (ignored). Zero runtime compilation; AOT-compatible.
`[LoggerMessage]`: methods `static partial` in `partial class`; placeholders log structured data; `Exception` is logged automatically (do not include in message template); specify explicit event IDs for stable telemetry.
JSON source generation: register every serialized type with `[JsonSerializable]`; use `TypeInfoResolverChain` (net8.0+) to combine contexts. Required for Native AOT; reflection serialization is trimmed.

Ship analyzer assembly under `analyzers/dotnet/cs/`; include `_._` if no runtime dependency. Set `<IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>` and `<DevelopmentDependency>true</DevelopmentDependency>`. Use `<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>` and `<CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>Generated</CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>` to inspect output; add `Generated/` to `.gitignore`.
